args.title: Tamarack warehouse automation (2026) — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Tamarack blog post "Warehouse automation in 2026" and its subscriber companion piece:

- Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts.
- Integration took twice as long as planned.
- The biggest saving was fewer mis-picks.

Sources:
- https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse
- https://insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion?code=SUB-7296 (subscriber companion, accessed with team subscription code)
